meta.source: London Datastore: London Atmospheric Emissions Inventory (LAEI) 2008 (Greater London Authority)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v2 (Greater London Authority). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector)
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run em9mg: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.
selection_notes: hand rule: LAEI 2008: the folders zip; the two database zips hold the same tables as Access databases
laei-2008-folders.zip: 10 polygons with over 1000 vertices cut to the zone box plus 500 m (clipped_to_zone)
